name: bf16-hopper-mma-k16
what: model replay of GemmCoordinate<16> on hopper_bf16_m16n8k16 (one group of 16, 26-bit adder, floor -133) from the recorded seed and recipe; every step's FP32 accumulator word and the f32_to_bf16 output word. Not a hardware capture: the evidence is the instruction pin the target names.

generator.recipe: random.Random(seed): per operand word u = rng.random(); sign = rng.randrange(2) << 15; u < 0.10 -> +-0 (0x0000/0x8000); u < 0.25 -> a subnormal (exponent field 0, fraction rng.randrange(1, 128)); u < 0.30 -> +-1.0 (0x3F80/0xBF80); else a normal word with exponent field rng.randrange(96, 160) (magnitudes 2^-31 .. 2^32, so a K=1536 chain stays finite) and fraction rng.randrange(128); the accumulator starts at +0.0 (0x00000000)
